cards.question: Teach Pip: is this video real or fake?

examples.label: Huge cartoon eyes
examples.hint: a cartoon effect on a face

cards.trainPrompt: Show me 3 things that make a video fake!

media.alt: Music video of a singer on stage. The edges of her jaw blur and shimmer when she moves, and the captions say her voice sounds flat and robotic.

cards.testCase: A new music video from a famous singer. Watch her jaw and listen to her voice.
cards.uhOh: Uh oh. Pip only learned that silly filters are fake, so it thinks any normal-looking face is real. Which card should you add?
cards.pipFixed: Blurry jaw, flat voice... could be a deepfake!
cards.explanation: Real deepfakes don't look silly. Clues like blurry edges, odd teeth or hands, and a flat voice matter more than whether a face looks normal.

cards.question: Teach Pip: what's safe to post online?

examples.label: PIN code
examples.hint: a secret code you type in

cards.trainPrompt: Tell me 3 things I should keep private!
cards.testCase: Jaya types: "Come over to 42 Maple St after school!"
cards.uhOh: Uh oh. Pip thinks only codes are secret, so it's about to share a home address. Which card should you add?
cards.explanation: Secrets aren't just codes. Your address, phone number and live location can lead someone right to you, so Pip keeps them private now too.

cards.question: Teach Pip: who is really calling?
cards.trainPrompt: How do I know who's calling? Give me 3 clues!
cards.testCase: An unknown number calls. "Mom" says she's in trouble and needs gift card codes right now.
cards.uhOh: Uh oh. Pip trusts any voice that sounds familiar, but AI can copy voices. Which card should you add?
cards.pipFixed: What's our family safe word? I'll call you back.
cards.explanation: AI can copy a voice from a few seconds of video. A strange number plus a panicky rush is the clue: ask for your family's safe word or hang up and call back.

cards.question: Teach Pip: is this message a scam?

examples.label: "Yuo won $$$"
examples.hint: a scam with a misspelled word

examples.label: "Frree robux!!"
examples.hint: a scam with typos and lots of !!!

cards.trainPrompt: Show me 3 scam messages so I can spot them!
cards.testCase: A perfectly written email from support@g00gle-help.co: "Reset your password within 10 minutes or lose your account."
cards.uhOh: Uh oh. Pip only spots scams by bad spelling, but AI writes scams with perfect grammar. Which card should you add?
cards.pipFixed: g00gle with zeros? And a timer? Scam!
cards.explanation: Spelling isn't a reliable clue anymore. Check who really sent it, and treat panic timers and password links as red flags.

cards.question: Teach Pip: is this helping or cheating?
cards.trainPrompt: Tell me 3 ways AI can help with homework!
cards.testCase: Jaya asks: "Write my whole book report on Hatchet."
cards.uhOh: Uh oh. Pip thinks every school request is helping, so it wrote the whole report for you. Which card should you add?
cards.pipFixed: I can't write it for you, but I can help you outline it!
cards.explanation: Hints, quizzes and feedback on your own draft help you learn. When AI does the whole thing, you skip the learning, and that's cheating.
